column1: # Custom partition table for 8 MB flash.
# Two changes from the old single-`factory` layout
# each needs a full erase and the device is hard to reach physically:
#  1. `factory` was 0x600000 while the app binary is ~1.2 MB — nearly 5 MB of
#     dead space.  The batched-record store needs room for suppressed-event
#     images at half the capture resolution (~60-100 KB each); the old 1 MB
#     `storage` could barely hold ten.
#  2. OTA slots
column2: because the device cannot be flashed remotely — it is

column1: #     power-gated and /dev/ttyACM0 only exists during a brief active window.
#     Reserving the slots now costs ~0.9 MB of store; adding them later would
#     cost another erase-flash and another trip to the device.
# ota_0/ota_1 are 0x190000 (1.6 MB) — 1.35x the current binary
# real headroom for growth while still leaving ~4.9 MB for batched records

column2: several days of backlog against a flush that happens every 20 min-2 h).
